cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll name who reported your lateness if you name who reported mine. You used to give away the whole story before I taught you to ask for something back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then offer the department, not a name you haven't got. I'll match it. You're still overpricing the label.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Payroll. But I can introduce you to my source.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Marketing. And coffee with my source for coffee with yours. Better—you've found something worth trading without inventing a name.

reason: Make the pupil relationship determine the kind of reassurance, trade, precision demand, expanding suspicion or hospitality being pursued. Preserve a responsive B and avoid explaining the pair to a reviewer in dialogue.
